result.title: MorphingNet: Symbolic Regression Where the Network Is the Formula
result.summary: We introduce MorphingNet, a network for symbolic regression (SR) whose units change their function continuously. Instead of searching over expressions built from a fixed operator library, MorphingNet trains the form of each function as a parameter, so SR becomes one continuous optimization problem. Its units are either pole-free rational functions or complex exponential--logarithm functions, which move between exponentials, sinusoids, damped oscillations, power laws and logarithms as their parameters change. The network is a readable formula at every step of training, and no operator library is needed to train it; a structure-recovery step afterwards rewrites the trained formula into short elementary expressions. Training is dense linear algebra, so it is GPU-friendly and scales to large data. MorphingNet achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on SRBench, recovers most generating formulas on synthetic benchmarks, and on large data is up to two orders of magnitude faster than the strongest search method. By turning the search for a formula into the training of a network, MorphingNet offers a new paradigm for SR and for scientific discovery from data.

AI.brief_summary: MorphingNet 提出一种符号回归网络：单元函数形式随参数连续变化（无极点有理函数或复指数—对数函数），使公式搜索变成连续优化，训练中网络本身即可读作公式，训练后再由结构恢复步骤重写成短表达式。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把离散结构搜索松弛为连续参数化、且中间状态始终「可读」的思路，可能与 latent 推理状态的生成与更新、以及内部状态可解释性的研究路线有概念上的类比，但联系较间接，可供核查。
